title: security: rbac v2 - KMS residency & audit logging enhancements
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Context: This PR hardens RBAC v2 by adding explicit KMS residency enforcement and richer audit logging for KMS-related policy decisions. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require enforcement of key residency combined with traceable audit events when keys are selected or overridden. Scope: policy validator changes, KMS residency check shim, audit event enrichment, installer template for private deployments, docs and integration tests.

Changes: - Add RequireKMSResidency flag support in RBAC v2 policy schema and validation path. - Introduce kms_residency.go shim to validate key region against policy constraints and to emit standardized audit events. - Enrich audit logging with fields: policy_id, decision, evaluated_principal, key_id, key_region, resolution_path. - Add installer kms-config.yaml to make residency policies available to Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. - Integration tests exercising pinning, override attempts, and audit events. - Docs: rbac/v2-kms-residency.md with examples and migration notes.

Checklist: - [x] Schema update and validation logic - [x] Audit events emitted with structured fields - [x] Integration tests covering positive/negative flows - [x] Docs and installer template updated - [x] Linear items linked (ENG-7942, SEC-214)

Commits summary: 3 commits: a1f3c9e (schema + validation), b7d2f11 (audit enrichment + logging helpers), c9e4a22 (installer template, docs, tests).

CI: initial push had one flaky integration failure (retry triggered). All CI checks green on final push.

Testing notes: Added integration test that simulates cross-region key use and validates that requests are rejected when residency enforced. Audit log ingestion consumer tests assert event payload schema.

Backward compatibility: Default behavior unchanged (RequireKMSResidency is opt-in). Migration guidance included in docs.

Security considerations: No plaintext key material is logged. Audit consumer uses redacted key material; only key_id and region are present. KMS interactions continue to use KMS client wrapper to centralize metrics and retries.

Merge: Squash-merged to main after approvals.
review_comments: Ethan Park (review) - Can we centralize the region-check logic into the existing key-resolution path to avoid duplication? Suggest moving isKMSRegionPinned into pkg/kms/resolver.go and adding unit tests there.

Aisha Kapoor (author) - I moved the core check into pkg/kms/resolver.go in the second commit and left a small shim in rbac to keep the RBAC surface minimal. Added unit tests for the resolver (see b7d2f11).

Jasmine Liu (review) - Audit payload looks good. Please ensure we have a migration note for customers that rely on custom audit parsers; field 'resolution_path' is new. Also verify that the audit log size doesn't regress appreciably.

Aisha Kapoor (author) - Added migration note in docs and added a compact mode flag in logging to limit array payloads. Measured avg audit event size +8% in test fixtures; acceptable given compliance benefit.
Ravi Menon (approval) - Approval after small nits addressed. Verified integration test behavior in a local private-installer run.
CI Bot - integration-tests failed on first run due to ephemeral key provisioning race; rerun succeeded.
release_notes: Enhancement: RBAC v2 can now enforce KMS key residency (opt-in). Audit logs enriched for KMS decisions to improve compliance traceability. Includes installer template for Private deployments and migration notes.
